issues.title: Missing Authoritative Source Context
issues.why: The module is explicitly 'derivative' and relies on spec/22 for all entity names, relationships, and logic, but spec/22 is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include spec/22-git-logs-v2 files in the prompt context to allow the AI to verify diagram-to-prose parity.

issues.title: Missing Mermaid Source Files
issues.why: The inventory lists 7 active .mmd files (01, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10), but the provided file list only contains the markdown documentation and puppeteer.json.
issues.fix: Provide the content of the .mmd files so the AI can audit the Mermaid syntax and logic against the ACs.

issues.title: Non-deterministic SVG Diffing
issues.why: AC-DG-12 and the Tooling Snippet require byte-perfect or SHA-256 matches for SVGs, but Mermaid renders often include non-deterministic IDs that break simple diffs.
issues.fix: Update the CI snippet to use a structural XML diff or strip generated IDs before SHA-256 hashing.
